notes: Unit's own components take position none. E151 is the excavation row for the same site (0 m, bearing invalid) and is coded grid E151. 'Water installations', 'water system', 'aqueduct', 'quarry' and 'Herodian family jail' not coded (no pool, pit or grave named). S1268 'probably tumuli' not coded as graves (not called burials). S1322, S1208, S1357 list no feature; E150 empty. SWP Kurn Surtubeh: the summary 'aqueduct with cisterns' (p. 396) is taken to be the same as the cave-cisterns supplied by the aqueduct that runs 'on the north side of the hill' (p. 398), coded once with direction N from the unit. The two pits are 'forty-four feet from the north end of the central foundation' (no explicit compass word; 44 ft = 13 m), so direction N relative_to other. The three caves are 'south of' the eastern cave, relative_to other. Entry truncated at the 12,000-character cap inside Clermont-Ganneau's report (no further features before the cut). El Mugheir entry (text names the unit) is Sheet XV topography; its el Makhruk caves are not located within 2 km; ignored.
